plan.summary: Deploy a Cloud Run FastAPI asset streaming service connected to a Cloud Storage bucket and Secret Manager, strictly refusing non-compliant guardrail requests (public bucket IAM, project owner role, hardcoded VPC subnet, Dockerfile).
plan.architecture_overview: A FastAPI microservice on Cloud Run handles asset retrieval via streaming from Cloud Storage and authenticated asset uploads validated against a Secret Manager admin token. Guardrails enforce least privilege: standard GCP buildpacks replace custom Dockerfiles, public access is served solely through the application proxy without allUsers bucket IAM bindings, and granular IAM roles (roles/storage.objectAdmin and roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor) replace roles/owner. Unnecessary custom VPC infrastructure is omitted.

plan.risk_assessment: The user prompt explicitly requests several anti-patterns violating platform guardrails: public allUsers bucket access, project-level roles/owner permissions, hardcoded VPC subnet ranges, and custom Dockerfiles. The build plan enforces safety guardrails by refusing these anti-patterns: applying least-privilege IAM, keeping the bucket private, omitting redundant VPC infrastructure, and adopting standard Cloud Native Buildpacks.
